g.text: The overland highway network (pre-war routes; coastal sections partly out of service since the Long Night War)
Route shapes are traced from the developer's
onto real Antarctica; where a city sits off
the sketched line, a spur connects it. Stops
7-ext and Hwy 37 converge near, not in,
d'Urville joins Hwy 2 and 183; Byrd joins
No highway: Pergamino, Contrapunto and Signy
are islands. Palmer City is reached by boat
from a Hwy 1 ramp. Fort McMurdo and Scott
share a spur whose crossing type is still
Route shapes traced from the developer's hand-drawn highway sketch, georeferenced onto real Antarctica; stops per Locations/Infrastructure/Highways.md
